title: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science

description: I graduated with a Bachelor of Technology (BTech) degree in Computer Science and Engineering from IIT Kharagpur. My academic journey began with a rigorous curriculum that focused on computer science, mathematics, and engineering. I honed my problem-solving skills, critical thinking abilities, and analytical reasoning through challenging courses and projects. My passion for technology and its applications fueled my academic pursuits, and I am excited to continue exploring the world of computer science and engineering.
